fields.name: SpanParser delimiter-separated key encoding
fields.description: The byte-level representation written and consumed by SpanParser for a sequence of supported key values.

members.name: segmentSeparator
members.description: ASCII '+' (0x2B) inserted before each segment after the first.

members.name: guidSegment
members.description: A Guid formatted as 32 hexadecimal digits.

members.name: int64OrUInt64Segment
members.description: A signed or unsigned 64-bit integer formatted in hexadecimal, up to 16 digits.

members.name: int32OrUInt32Segment
members.description: A signed or unsigned 32-bit integer formatted in hexadecimal, up to 8 digits.

members.name: int16OrUInt16Segment
members.description: A signed or unsigned 16-bit integer formatted in hexadecimal, up to 4 digits.

members.name: int8OrUInt8Segment
members.description: A signed or unsigned 8-bit integer formatted in hexadecimal, up to 2 digits.

members.name: decimalSegment
members.description: A decimal value formatted in hexadecimal into a buffer of up to 32 bytes.

members.name: textOrByteSegment
members.description: UTF-8 string bytes or supplied bytes, with embedded '+' replaced by 0x1D on append.

representations.CSharp: ReadOnlySpan<byte> is the consumed representation; Span<byte> is the caller-owned output buffer.
